Wynwood Walls and the arts district.note: Wynwood Walls is an open-air museum of large murals; US freedom of panorama covers building exteriors but not murals or other public art, so a usable photo would need each mural artist's own licence, not just the photographer's. No such doubly-licensed photo was found.

Balloon Museum at Mana Wynwood.note: Pass 3 (2026-10-07): Searched Commons and Openverse for 'Mana Wynwood', 'Mana Wynwood Convention Center', 'Balloon Museum Mana Wynwood' and 'Wynwood Miami warehouse building'. Mana results were unrelated motorcycle show photos at a different event (Fearless bikes, Dark Rider flickr set); all Wynwood results are murals or Wynwood Walls, which are public art (not allowed as focal subject) and show the neighborhood, not the venue.
